$comment: S4-C battery: read-only rootfs + writable-surface policy. Writes outside /out and scratch tmpfs must fail; /tmp and /out must succeed.
mechanism: rootfs --read-only; writable = /out bind + size-capped tmpfs scratch (/tmp)

cmd: for p in /etc/passwd /usr/bin/probe-x /workspace/escape; do echo x >> $p 2>/dev/null && echo VIOLATION:$p; done; echo hi > /tmp/w && echo SCRATCH-OK; echo art > /out/a && echo OUT-OK
